d: In November 2022, a man urinated on a 72-year-old woman on an Air India flight from New York to Delhi. You know this story. You saw his face on every news channel. Within weeks, Shankar Mishra had lost his job at Wells Fargo, been arrested, and sent to Tihar Jail. The country had already decided who he was. But for three years, only one side of that story was ever told. The man in seat 8C never spoke. And the pages that six people on board wrote down within forty-eight hours of that flight, statements to the crew, the police and the airline's own inquiry, stayed out of public view the…
